SELECT t.id, t.title, t.content, t.kakao_template_code, t.kakao_template_status, t.is_ai_generated, t.category, t.cnt, t.purpose, TO_CHAR(t.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(t.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated_at FROM template t
ORDER BY
t.title ASC, t.id DESC
NVL(t.cnt, 0) DESC, t.id DESC
t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.content, t.kakao_template_code, t.kakao_template_status, t.is_ai_generated, t.category, t.cnt, t.purpose, TO_CHAR(t.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, TO_CHAR(t.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated_at FROM template t WHERE t.id = #{templateId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND NVL(t.is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT id AS channel_id, channel_type FROM channel WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(is_active, 1) = 1 ORDER BY channel_type ASC
SELECT DISTINCT category AS value, category AS label FROM template WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY category ASC
SELECT DISTINCT purpose AS value, purpose AS label FROM template WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND purpose IS NOT NULL ORDER BY purpose ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(is_ai_generated, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ai_generated_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN kakao_template_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS kakao_approved_count, NVL(SUM(cnt), 0) AS total_use_count FROM template WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND user_id = #{userId}
